content.label:
I love that it is easy to find what I need in Overcast. The search function works better than some other apps. It’s so much more agile than iOS Podcasts app and does not clog users my phone memory. The settings are clear. The developers clearly have a GSOH and are human. Thanks. 

Nitpicky details. : / Maybe we could pin our fave casts to the top? Or make as favourites?
Been using Overcast for 2 months now, as I can no longer use Apple podcast, as its recent update was absolutely awful. Wish I had discovered Overcast sooner. 10/10.
Sadly I’ve had to stop using overcast for the moment as it no longer works with AirPort Express. Hoping for a fix
Doesn’t seem to work.  Feels like an empty app.  Searching for podcasts finds nothing.   Nothing recommended.  Custom urls complain no internet connection.  Big waste of time so far.

This has been my go to podcast player for years but the latest update has loads of crashes and problems remembering where you were in a podcast. Didn’t want to but went back to Apple podcast app which is worse than overcast but doesn’t just stop playing randomly. Was 5 star now is 1 star useless.

I’ve been looking for a better podcast app for some time, and tried  numerous ones before discovering Overcast. It works, it’s clear, and you can tell it to stop playback at the end of an episode instead of jumping to the most recent episode of a podcast as soon as the current episode finishes. There are also nice features like the sleep timer.

The free version is fine and the ads aren’t too intrusive. I’d buy it as a one-off purchase, but I think the annual fee is a bit steep.

title.label: Great redesign/rework of the best podcast app

content.label:
I’m really liking the new design and rework that has been done. This has also allowed for more iterative improvements with new updates which has been appreciated. This has included adding a dedicated sleep timer and streaming option. Really liking the new panel at the top giving you quick access to play recent episodes. 

Small issue is that sometimes it’s quite easy to move to a new chapter when just scrolling through the chapter list. 

But overall easily the best podcast app!

By far the best podcast app I have ever used. Most of them seem overly complex and have hidden agendas behind them attempting to get you to either join a premium service, spend money on those essentials that nobody needs, or to listen to stuff that is of no interest to you. Simple to use, good coverage of topics, and good features. Just get it!

I’ve used this app for many years. The recent “revamp” looks better and responds faster BUT ….. why have you removed the facility to just simply DOWNLOAD a podcast to listen later. A very basic function surely. I saw the explanation about more pods being streamed and better quality but I think it’s a big omission that is seriously making me consider other platforms.

Fantastic app - smart speed option useful, works smoothly and enjoyably.

Update to UI is excellent, and yet it doesn't feel like a significant change because it keeps the same style.

Regularly updated.

Overcast used to be a simple, functional app. However, since the latest update the app has become clunky and unreliable. 
Sync is, at best, unpredictable and often does not work at all - sending you back to the beginning of a podcast and completely clearing the queue.
I’ll give it a few weeks to see if things improve, but I think I’ll be cancelling my subscription and moving to another app.

title.label: All these years and still in love…

content.label: I’ve used Overcast since version one and still love it. It has changed bit by bit and many times over the years but stayed clearly focused on its core function. Marco has seriously speeded up sync in the latest version, very welcome. For me the most useful non core feature is the ability to upload your own audio files to a server Marco maintains and then listen to them via the app.

title.label: Used to be great but is now a buggy mess

content.label: When playing an episode of a podcast it will constantly just suddenly stop the episode and delete the download. I googled and it’s a common bug, and some people have had limited success changing the setting to allow an unlimited number of episodes to be downloaded and stored. Unfortunately that hasn't worked for me. A podcast app that will constantly stop the podcast you’re listening to, delete it and then reset your episode progress is entirely useless.

title.label: Fails at basic "does it work" test.

content.label: Frequently crashes, won't let you stream or download when not on wifi (despite changing settings). Strange UI, with an alphabetised list, and hard to know when someone's updated. Deleted after a couple of months as, as the most essential level, it did not work.
The update has caused some podcasts to no longer appear in my feed and for some episodes to constantly stop playing. Please fix it quickly!

I used to be able to click on an episode notification from my lock screen and add to queue, that hasn’t worked since the revamp. Now the latest update won’t even open new episodes and when I manually search for them they don’t display, but they are there in different podcast apps. I’m really trying to stay with the app as it was always so good. I do like the new scrubbing lock as I always scrubbed along by accident from lock screen. Hoping for a fix soon and I’ll update review.

Overcast has all the features I need from a podcast app as well as more I didn’t know I wanted. The interface is simple yet versatile and the customisation has made my life so much easier. Are there some podcasts you want to download immediately while leaving the rest until you’re ready to listen? No problem. Are you too impatient to sit through intros and outros? You can set the app to skip pre-set amounts of time for each feed. I personally don’t stream podcasts, but it’s great the developer listened to the users and brought that feature back. Thank you, Overcast!

I’ve been an overcast user since 2014. I have tried everything else out of curiosity on the store, yes even that one! And I always come back to Overcast. Why? It’s got the best audio engine. Doesn’t mess you around with “Lifetime” subs that turn out not to be lifetime. Hasn’t been passed to 4 different owners. Hasn’t been closed down by a trillion dollar company. It’s been there constantly for the last 10 years and is made by one person. Long may it continue!
I updated and the features I liked are gone. No play next, and the app crashes randomly. Now i use Spotify

This app has been the best podcast experience on iOS for years and that hasn’t changed. 

The recent redesign has had some teething issues but the developer clearly has a passion to make this the best there is, with tiny minor settings that make users use of this app better.
Marco addressed the feedback and has fixed all the issues I encountered since the rewrite in a very short period of time. This is once again the best podcast app on the App Store
This app is the king of podcast players. Marco has put an incredible amount of thought and polish into the app, and it is a joy to use. Probably the most frequently used app on my phone. Keep it up!!

I looked around for alternatives after iTunes messed up syncing one too many times, and decided to give Overcast a go. Within a few days I had removed all my subscriptions from iTunes and a few days after that I became a patron. I subscribe to around 30 podcasts, and dip into a lot more. Not once has Overcast let me down.
… and back to its rightful place on my home screen. The best podcast app, bar none.

“New Nitpicky Detail to disable Lock Screen time-scrubbing, in case you do it accidentally a lot”

I beg to differ. 

Also, how many times can a user be presented a full screen “Add podcast” ad when returning to the app before the user goes elsewhere? 

Marco, perhaps you might consider disabling the ratings prompt you’ve “held out for 8 years….” until you’ve fixed your app that…frankly, for 8 years…worked perfectly up until recently.

Unfortunately the recent update has downgraded the app from 5 to 2 stars for me due to the constant crashes during playback and streams/downloads not starting.

I’m hopeful the issues will get fixed in a future update and will update my review if it does.

Until then I’m sadly switching to another app as I listen to multiple podcasts per day and this instability is too frustrating.

Unfortunately, since a recent update, playback of episodes keeps stopping randomly, resulting in progress being lost completely; essentially rendering the app unusable. I have had to switch to the Apple podcast app, which is a shame as I prefer Overcast overall and would love to support the developers.

Would be keen to switch back once this is fixed.

I’ve tried to get use to it for the last month but they’ve gone for style over user experience and it’s a painful to use. 

The queue system is all the place. Gone is the quick play next, it might be there but I can’t find it easily which tells you all about this redesign.

title.label: Once again the best podcast app

content.label:
It’s been a rough few months but Overcast got back. 

The new code base allowing much more rapid development of new features is fantastic. Smart Speed is best in class. Would not use anything else.

Used to be the best podcast app on iOS until the recent update which removed some features and broke others. 

Shame. Now moved to a more expensive competitor that rhymes with Rocket Cats

Was brilliant but since September 2024 it’s really poor with podcasts simply stopping at random times and then when you reconnect it just goes back to the start.!
I’ve used to happily for years but for no apparent reason it’s become almost unusable. Sad.

Amazing podcast app, the only one I end up using. 

However I come here to complain. Since I’ve updated to iOS 18, I cannot listen to podcasts longer that 5 mins. Somehow the app resets and when I run a podcast again - it starts from the beginning.

Overcast has been my podcast app for years now, never really had any issues, but since a recent update it has been rendered completely useless. Doesn’t keep it’s place in podcasts, downloaded or not, forcing you to start from scratch each time, that is if you can get it to play an episode in the first place… Even when it does decide to play something, in my experience it’ll still just randomly pause, then when you try to resume, shock, forget your position and start over from the beginning. The app is absolutely unusable, and it’s a damn shame because overcast used to be fantastic at what it did. Unfortunately I’m going to have to look elsewhere for an app I can actually use, but hope the problems will get fixed soon, though doubt I’ll be around by then to find out. Disappointed.
Unusable until they fix the bugs

The developer is working ridiculously hard to make Overcast work how everyone wants it to, which is an almost impossible task. Leaving one and two star reviews is not a fair reflection of the effort being put in or on the quality of the app.

Overcast is a fantastic app which I use all the time and the fact that the developer cares enough about their users to work so hard to get things right is a bonus, not a failing.

Overcast is a fantastic app and I don't hesitate to recommend it.
Recently migrated from Apple Podcasts and loved Overcast initially. Now (despite redownloading) it stops every 10 minutes and loses its place. Happens on all my devices. Unusable now.

Had this app for years and it has been my go to app, but after recent updates it will stop mid podcast and go back to the beginning. Sometimes this happens when I get an audio alert from another app other times it seems to be at random. Very frustrating but will persevere in case it gets fixed.
Loved this app but the recent update has left it unusable. Podcasts stop after a few minutes, position not saved. Will be moving to a different app from now unless a fix is imminent.
As others have stated - so buggy recently, podcast just stops playing and then starts from scratch when you reload it. Will be looking at alternatives after this for weeks now.

title.label: Buggy to the point of unusable.

content.label: This app used to be my go-to podcast app until recently when it starting failing to download episodes, failing to keep hold of time codes  in episodes and finally just stopping playing episodes all together. It is now utterly useless as an app. Have had to start using Apple Podcasts which im glad to see has improved!

Have used and loved this app for years, but with the latest update it has become unusable. As others have reported a podcast stops playing and then forgets where you were. Many of the podcasts I follow briefly appear then totally disappear and I can only see episodes from months or years ago. I have faith that the developer is reading these reviews and will fix soon. If not then I will have to find an alternative. Please fix!

I started using Overcast back when apple ruined the standard podcasts app, this does everything you’ll ever want from a catcher and does it slick and quick. Favourite features are Smart Speed and Voice Boost 😍

How did this update get past QA and testing!! 
It’s awful as so many people are pointing out. The app is now unusable so after many years using I’m deleting. D switching to another app.
Extremely buggy since the revamp sadly. Sound stops, podcast closes and when you reopen it’s back at the start. Very sad.
This app use to be great.  But recently podcasts to which I subscribe stopped appearing in my feed.   Creating a new profile and adding subscriptions again seems to be working, but is a nuisance.

title.label: Completely ruined a perfect app for seemingly no reason

content.label:
The changes to queues and removing ability to play next was already a pain, but the app is not just completely unusable, as playback crashes after 5 mins without remembering where you left off.

Time to look for something else after 5+ years of Overcast

title.label: Good app but broken features ruins the experience

content.label: This app is as good as any for podcasting. At least, it was… unfortunately the new update as meant that podcasts I have added to the queue will sometimes stop playing, disappear from the queue and then I have to work out where I was and start playing. If you’re listening to a pod, it can’t be added back to the queue, adding to the frustration. The queue now doesn’t really work at all and podcasts don’t seem to want to play automatically from oldest to newest in each podcast’s feed, making consecutively listening to episodes a real pain. Despite the admin involved, I think I’ll have to move apps again.

title.label: Huge time saver, great iPhone and iPad versions

content.label:
I really like Overcast would never switch to another podcast app, my main reason is the massive time saving that comes with the “smart speed” function that simply “shortens silences” as the UI aptly tells you. But there are many other reasons why I love this app:
The developer clearly takes a lot of care not only planning his app overall and its features, but also closely monitors usage and user feedback.
His complete rewrite of his app using Swift originally got a lot of, er, constructive criticism, mainly about the streaming function having been removed. He brought it back, even though it meant a lot of additional coding in the new system and a lot of server overhead and other complications. Streaming means that you can start playing a podcast immediately before the episode has downloaded fully. It makes a huge difference to me.
Also: With the Swift rewrite, the iPad version now is absolutely gorgous and I can see myself starting to use it regularly when listening at home.
Overcast is the app I recomend to those who listen to podcasts a lot. Casual podcast users might as well stick to Apple’s basic app, but you will quickly find it indispensable if you are a regular podcast listener.

2nd update review:- getting better but still hanker after the play next function. Unless I’m missing something in settings/queue. 

Update review:- mini update has brought back the missing features that made it a great app except the play next function that makes it car friendly on commute to work. Original version was 10 stars. Not now. I appreciate that with new technology things need to be updated but some of the functions that made this a fantastic app have disappeared. Play next and being able to sort all and current podcasts differently were so useful. I now find that unless you are looking at your phone it isn’t as car friendly as it was. I feel that this app has become a clone of the others that I chose not to use.
The last few days, my podcasts have not been saving their progress. I’m having to restart and try to find manually where I was last listening. It’s becoming frustrating
